lines.text: On October 28th, the hostel internet died twice: at 5:34 in the morning, and again at 3:28 in the afternoon. Both times, we caught exactly why.
On the hostel network, every device first asks one question: who is the router?
The real router, a MikroTik, answers with its hardware address. From then on, all internet traffic flows through it.
lines.say: The real router, a Micro-Tik, answers with its hardware address. From then on, all internet traffic flows through it.

lines.text: At 5:34 and 3 seconds, another device on the network started answering instead. Its message: I am the router.
The laptop believed it, and so did two other devices nearby.
From that moment, every packet went to the impostor. 71 packets went out. Zero came back.
That's why Discord shows five thousand milliseconds, friends can't hear you, and pages load forever, with no error at all.
Nothing comes back, so nothing can even fail properly.
It lasted two and a half minutes, until the cable was pulled. netbug recorded every second of it.
lines.say: It lasted two and a half minutes, until the cable was pulled. Net-bug recorded every second of it.

lines.text: To be sure, we removed the protection and waited.
At 3:28 that afternoon, it happened again.
Same device. Same address. Same lie. 42 packets out, zero back.
This time, four other devices lost the router too, and the capture caught the attacker looking up its next victim: one it had already cut off that morning.
Every detail matched. This is not a broken router or a bad cable. Someone on this network is cutting people off on purpose.
The fix on the laptop is to pin the real router's address. Fake replies are then simply ignored.
After pinning, reconnecting worked instantly. But the pin protects only this laptop, and only its outgoing traffic.
For the hostel team: find this device on the MikroTik, then turn on client isolation and ARP protection. That protects everyone.
lines.say: For the hostel team: find this device on the Micro-Tik, then turn on client isolation and A.R.P. protection. That protects everyone.
